title: Peaceful
description:
Unwind in Franklin, Tennessee, located in Northern Williamson County.  Enjoy this lovely apartment on the bottom floor of our house that is named Peaceful.

The space
The apartment has 2 bedrooms (one with a queen bed and the other with a trundle bed that has twin beds one of which does not pop up.)  This superb property provides a soothing retreat for guests.  It is located on 3 wooded acres with wildlife to enjoy.  Included is an electric fireplace with a fullly equipped kitchen.  Enjoy your morning coffee (provided) and the wildlife on the patio. The bathroom features a bathtub with shower, double sinks, and a hair dryer for added convenience.  Also included is WiFi, a 42" TV on Dish with Amazon Prime and a full-sized washing machine and dryer.  Whether you want to explore the charming city of Franklin or the city of Brentwood (both are 10 minutes away) or want the downtown Nashville experience (20 minutes away) or simply relax in the apartment, we know you will enjoy your visit and accommodations.
